professionalSummary.text: Developed fleet traffic-management and task-allocation services in C++ and Python for industrial robotics applications.
professionalSummary.witness: Rewrote the task-allocation service in C++ at Brannock Automation so that robots are assigned picks by estimated travel time rather than straight-line distance.

professionalSummary.text: Extended a layout simulator to include one-way aisle rules and charger queues, validated customer layouts before floor plan changes.
professionalSummary.witness: Added one-way aisle rules and charger queues to the Python layout simulator, and ran each customer's proposed layout through it before the site engineers changed the floor plan.

professionalSummary.text: Achieved a 4.4 percentage point reduction in robot idle time (from 14.0% to 9.6%) at Daventry and Leeds sites through a C++ task-allocation service update.
professionalSummary.witness: At the Daventry and Leeds customer sites, robot idle time went from 14.0% of shift time in the baseline fortnight (6 to 19 February 2023) to 9.6% after the new allocation went into service (20 March to 2 April 2023), measured from fleet telemetry.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote field diagnostics for stalled robots, including path plan and sensor state dumps, and supported site engineers on the weekday rota.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote a field diagnostics command that dumps a stalled robot's path plan and sensor state, and joined the weekday support rota for site engineers.

experienceHighlights.text: Followed safety-related software process including hazard-log entries, peer code review, and safety case test reports for the allocation service.
experienceHighlights.witness: Followed the company's safety-related software process for the allocation service: hazard-log entries, code review by a second engineer and test reports filed for the safety case.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Telemetry comparison report for Daventry and Leeds sites showing idle-time reduction from 14.0% to 9.6% with baseline and post-change data, fleet manager's idle-time definition, release date (13 March 2023), and site manager acknowledgements.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the telemetry comparison report for the two sites, with idle-time tables for the baseline and post-change fortnights (14.0% and 9.6% of shift time), the fleet manager's definition of idle time, the allocation release date (13 March 2023) and acknowledgements from both site operations managers.

skills.text: C++ and Python for fleet traffic-management and task-allocation services.
skills.witness: Rewrote the task-allocation service in C++ at Brannock Automation so that robots are assigned picks by estimated travel time rather than straight-line distance.

skills.text: Safety-related software process compliance including hazard-log entries, peer code review, and safety case documentation.
skills.witness: Followed the company's safety-related software process for the allocation service: hazard-log entries, code review by a second engineer and test reports filed for the safety case.

evidence.text: Rewrote the task-allocation service in C++ at Brannock Automation so that robots are assigned picks by estimated travel time rather than straight-line distance.

evidence.text: Added one-way aisle rules and charger queues to the Python layout simulator, and ran each customer's proposed layout through it before the site engineers changed the floor plan.

evidence.text: At the Daventry and Leeds customer sites, robot idle time went from 14.0% of shift time in the baseline fortnight (6 to 19 February 2023) to 9.6% after the new allocation went into service (20 March to 2 April 2023), measured from fleet telemetry.

Work sample: the telemetry comparison report for the two sites, with idle-time tables for the baseline and post-change fortnights (14.0% and 9.6% of shift time), the fleet manager's definition of idle time, the allocation release date (13 March 2023) and acknowledgements from both site operations managers.
evidence.notes: Supports the telemetry data with a work sample.

evidence.text: Wrote a field diagnostics command that dumps a stalled robot's path plan and sensor state, and joined the weekday support rota for site engineers.
